newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Benefun to issue 100 mln shrs at HK$1.15/shr.
newsitem.headline: Benefun to issue 100 mln shrs at HK$1.15/shr.

text.p: Casual wear retailer Benefun International Holdings Ltd said on Monday it is issuing 100 million new shares at HK$1.15 each in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The issue price represents a proforma fully-diluted price/earnings multiple of 7.9 times and a weighted average multiple of 6.5 times.
The prospective annual dividend yield is seven percent and adjusted net tangible asset value per share is HK$0.66.
The IPO will run from May 20-27 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on June 3. The company has applied for a primary listing in Hong Kong and a secondary listing in Singapore.
NatWest Securities Hong Kong is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
Benefun, which makes and retails branded casual wear in China, Taiwan and Hong Kong, is made up of three companies -- Fun Corp, Benefashion Hong Kong and Benefashion Taiwan.
Singapore-listed Heshe Holdings Ltd holds 75 percent of Fun Corp and 100 percent of the two Benefashion companies.
Heshe's entire stake will be distributed among its shareholders after the Benefun shares are listed, a NatWest official told Reuters.
The net proceeds of HK$100 million will be used to further develop Benefun's retail network, expand production facilities in China and reduce the group's short-term bank loans.
The company forecasts a combined profit after taxation and minority interest but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$54.5 million for the year ended on June 30, 1997.
Benefun recorded a profit of HK$38.83 million for the year ended in June 1996, up from HK$33.21 million in 1995 and HK$28.99 million in 1994.
